newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY BOURSE TAKES UP KIRALYBROKER AS MEMBER.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY BOURSE TAKES UP KIRALYBROKER AS MEMBER.

text.p: The Council of the Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) decided to list Kiralybroker Ertekpapir-forgalmazo Kft as a member of the bourse, the BSE said in a statement in its official gazette on Monday.

The decision will take effect on March 11. The BSE also said in a separate statement that it would terminate the bourse membership of Co-Nexus Ertekhaz Rt for the request of the brokerage, effective on March 10.
Kiralybroker's registered capital is 52.1 million forints.
